name: Mojtaba Khamenei
summary: Mojtaba Khamenei was long a private figure in the Supreme Leader's office and became Supreme Leader in March 2026. His only recorded positions are written messages read on state television during the 2026 war, which call for continued defense, revenge for the dead, keeping the Strait of Hormuz closed and closing US bases in neighbouring states. None of these maps onto a statement in the test, so no position is recorded.
